title: Cluster Connection Visibility Wizard and Upgrade Impact Simulator
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Operators and platform engineers deploying Redwood Private often lack a concise way to understand how a planned runtime or kernel upgrade will ripple through VPC peering, cluster-to-cluster connectivity, and regional fallbacks. Current console pages are fragmented (network graphs, cluster list, and upgrade scheduler are separate), causing uncertainty before scheduled maintenance. Goal: Design a single, guided 'Connection Visibility Wizard' that walks an operator through the impact surface of a planned change and an integrated 'Upgrade Impact Simulator' that previews service-level status propagation, affected routes, and per-cluster cost delta. Deliverables: high-fidelity prototype, annotated interaction spec for engineers, accessibility review notes, and a lightweight A/B test plan for rollout to select accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype showcases end-to-end flow from selecting an upgrade to viewing affected clusters and routes
Simulator visualizes status propagation timeline (0-24h) for primary/replica clusters with color-coded severity
UI exposes per-cluster estimated token and GPU cost delta for the upgrade scenario
Design tokens and components use existing console system (no new primitives) and pass contrast/accessibility checks
Engineering has list of required telemetry events and API calls documented in the interaction spec
PM approves handoff and schedule for canary release in console-2026.03
comments: 2026-02-20 - Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after discovery session with Platform SREs. Key asks: show precise egress paths, mark peering links that would be impacted by kernel-level changes, and estimate cost delta for burst traffic during rollout.

2026-02-25 - Miguel Ortega: Pushed first low-fi flows to Figma (flow v0.1). Focused on a three-step wizard: (1) select upgrade + scope, (2) inspect affected topology, (3) run simulator. Need eng input on what 'scope' can be (cluster, label selector, region).

2026-03-01 - Priya Nambiar (PM): PM feedback - add explicit rollback impact view and tie simulator to existing rollout policies (canary/percentage). Also highlight operations steps for on-call in the timeline.

2026-03-03 - Derek Liu (SRE): Engineering review - API constraints noted: we can compute affected routes via /api/v1/topology/impact but cost delta needs batched metrics from billing service; suggested field list included in interaction spec.

2026-03-05 - Accessibility review (Samira Khan): Raised color contrast concerns for the three-way severity palette; recommend using patterned overlays for colorblind users and keyboard-first interactions for wizard steps.

2026-03-07 - Design critique: Iterate on compact topology inspector that allows expanding a cluster card to see inbound/outbound peering with latency and bandwidth estimates. Also add a 'what-if' toggle to simulate partial rollouts.

2026-03-09 - Miguel Ortega: Updated hi-fi prototype (flow v1.3) and added annotated handoff doc with telemetry event names and mock API responses. Ready for PM sign-off. Next: schedule 1-hour walkthrough with eng + SRE and set up a small usability session with two platform engineers.
